text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With summer camp finally drawing to a
close, I'm
working late into the evening
when all of a
sudden...
Hwaaagh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear a tremendous noise coming from
the
kitchen, so I rush over to check it
out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Look, I've picked the bowl up already.
Can you
stand up? Don't panic—just
take it slow.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Nngh, I'm sorry! Th-thank you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Gyah?! Now your trainer's here! I'm sorry
for
making such a racket!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's getting really exciting in here!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-well... Urara was hungry, so I thought
we could
cook up a late-night snack
together...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But then, guess what? The bowl flew
into the air
and the pot came crashing
down on the floor! It
was so funny!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Aaagh! I'm so sorry for being such a
clumsy dope!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Every... everything turned into complete
chaos,
but... Ayabe came to save the
day!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Not true... I just came to make myself
some food.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide not to mention that thought.
Doing so
would be pretty tactless of me.
choice_data_list: (Still, she rushed over faster than I did.)
(Still, she rushed over faster than I did.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I guess I can finally get started
on
dinner.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Are you both okay with sandwiches?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Are you gonna make us sandwiches
too?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Well, I came here to make something for
myself,
so... I might as well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I can't help you if you don't like what's
on the
menu, though.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm not particularly good at cooking. I
can't even
bake. Sandwiches are my
limit.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-n-no! It sounds great! Are you sure
you don't
mind though?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's only a few extra sandwiches.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So no complaints? I'll get started then. It
won't
take too long.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-wait! L-let me help out! I-I won't get
in the
way! I promise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega gets to work preparing the

sandwiches... and she looks like a real
natural in
the kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I put the cucumber and tomato
in this
sandwich, but they're making the
bread all soggy!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Sprinkle on a little salt and let it sit.
Then wipe off
the excess moisture with a
paper towel.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I've already portioned out the salt, so...
use that
over there.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ayabeee! Thank yooou! Now I feel like I
won't
mess anything up!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Ayabe! There's a banana over
there!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Think it'll taste good in our sandwiches?
Should
we try and see?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You want to add fruit?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
How about some orange instead of
banana? It
would probably go better
with the ham and
lettuce.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Orange! Yeah! Orange sounds good! I'll
peel one,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Once you've peeled it, put it back on
the
chopping board. I'll cut it into
circles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not long after...

text_block_list.name: Doto and Urara
text_block_list.text: So delicious!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe's sandwich tastes like it's filling
you with
lots and lots of energy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I love the sweet and tangy orange slices!
It's so
good! It's super-duper good!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Stop overreacting...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega appears bothered by their
praise,
but anyone who saw the
sandwiches would be
impressed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She handled everything so effortlessly,
especially
while dealing with her two
clueless assistants.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I've just had a lot of opportunities to
make them.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
They're easy to take with you too... like
when I go
to look at the stars.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So... it's not that I like them particularly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I guess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I calmly watch as the girls savor their
late-evening
sandwiches.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hey...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If you leave it too long, it'll fall apart. I
can wrap
it up if you're not hungry.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It'd be strange if you were the only one I
didn't
make one for...
choice_data_list: ...Wait, you actually had a portion for me?!
...Wait, there was a portion for me?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There were four of us in the kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess she has a point, but I'm left quite

astonished by her dutiful attitude.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Are you going to eat it now? If not, I'll
wrap it up
and put it in the fridge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Which one should I choose though?
choice_data_list: N-No, I'm digging in right now!
N-No, I'm digging in right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to go with the BLT she made
with Meisho
Doto.
choice_data_list: A real energy boost! The "BLT Sandwich"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a bite, and the savory taste of the
carefully
crisped bacon floods my
mouth, complemented
perfectly by the
juicy textures of cucumber and
tomato!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It looks like your trainer is
enjoying the
sandwich too, Ayabe.
That's so great.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And thanks to you, I actually managed
to make
something without screwing
up...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm sooo grateful!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Please... you're being dramatic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to go with the orange sandwich
she made
with Haru Urara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The salty ham and the tangy orange go

surprisingly well together. With the
healthy
portion of lettuce, it's a
beautifully balanced
meal!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay! And you know what? It's a flavor
full of
kindness!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
When I said I wanted to help make it,
Ayabe
didn't say no!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's a sandwich full of
kindness made
by Ayabe, who's also full
of kindness!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That doesn't make sense...
